climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A small Friuli-Venezia Giulia wine zone in the provinces of Trieste and Gorizia, on the Slovenian border. It is named for the Karst Plateau, became a DOC in 1985, and covers just 140 acres. It makes both red and white wine.
